Raw evidence index: all 6 artifact hashes match and all 72 matching_source_files hashes match the frozen task. Only observation (P3, no grading impact): instruction.md:15 says '/assets and /instructions are unavailable at runtime', while task.toml:2 declares artifacts ["/app", "/assets"] and test.sh:88 runs 'chmod -R a+rX /assets' in the verifier, implying /assets may be present at grading time. The instruction is the conservative direction (copy seed into /app, which hireops_rules.md:198-201 and the golden also do), so a conforming app cannot be misgraded and no app that reads /assets would be failed by it; it is a wording mismatch about a runtime fact, not a defect. Attempted counterexamples: (a) broken app ignoring PORT and hardcoding 3000 still passes - correct, since test.sh sets 3000 everywhere; (b) app ignoring DB_PATH writing beside its module - works in both /app and the writable copy, consistent with rules section 8; (c) conforming app reading the seed from /app copy - works; no conforming alternative found that a cross-file drift would fail. Not verified: whether Harbor actually materialises /assets in the separate verifier (no runtime record inspected for this); irrelevant to scores because the instruction steers away from runtime /assets use.
